newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-DAVIDSON GIVES LIONS A BOOST.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-DAVIDSON GIVES LIONS A BOOST.

text.p: Ireland lock Jeremy Davidson has given the British Lions team to tour South Africa a boost by making a quick recovery from a hamstring injury.
Davidson sustained the injury last Saturday playing for London Irish against Harlequins but could be back in action next week.
"The good news is that the injury is a strain and not a tear. He has been to the physio and there doesn't seem to be a long term problem," a London Irish team spokesman said.
He added Davidson would miss this Saturday's game with Northampton but could return for next Wednesday's match against Leicester.
